description: Rocketfuel ISP topology maps is provided by University of Washington. Rocketfuel publishes inferred ISP router topologies built from routing information, traceroutes, naming conventions and alias resolution. The original collection covers ten ISPs across Europe, Australia and the United States. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Documented formats: not established on the reviewed page. The cited material was readable without payment. Reuse licence: Not stated on the reviewed page; check provider terms before reuse.  The maps are historical inferences and may omit links or misresolve router interfaces; they are not current inventories. Potential simulation use: Provide reference ISP network graphs for routing and resilience experiments.
